sections.title: Audio files
sections.description: Forge saves a reference to each file but does not copy it. Moving, renaming, or deleting the file will break that action. Store your sounds somewhere permanent.

controls.label: Linux player command (optional)
controls.description: Leave blank to let Forge find ffplay, paplay, or aplay.

sections.title: Audio automations
sections.description: Attach Play audio file to triggers registered by Twitch Redeems or any other installed trigger plugin.
